saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 8ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Σωσθένης, Κηφάς, Απολλώς, Τυχικός, Καίσαρ και Επαφρόδιτος οι Απόστολοι εκ των Εβδομήκοντα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 8 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is the same man, the apostle of the Seventy named with his household in Paul's letter to the Philippians. The entry names all six of its members and gives each his own couplet and paragraph, so each is a folder and each relates the others. The page gives him the see of Korone in the Peloponnese with the hedge «φέρεται ότι χρημάτισε», it is reported that he held, so it is not written into `office`. It gives no year. The day's one hymn names Tychicus and is his, not this man's. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (25 September 2026).
